title: Predicting the DNA binding specificity of transcription factor mutants using family-level biophysically interpretable machine learning.
authors: Liu, Shaoxun; Gomez-Alcala, Pilar; Leemans, Christ; Glassford, William J; Melo, Lucas A N; Lu, Xiang-Jun; Mann, Richard S; Bussemaker, Harmen J
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文用可解释机器学习预测转录因子突变体的DNA结合特异性，聚焦TF-DNA互作与结合自由能变化，方法可迁移且高度匹配本课题。
abstract: Sequence-specific interactions of transcription factors (TFs) with genomic DNA underlie many cellular processes. High-throughput in vitro binding assays coupled with machine learning have made it possible to accurately define such molecular recognition in a biophysically interpretable way for hundreds of TFs across many structural families, providing new avenues for predicting how the sequence preference of a TF is impacted by disease-associated mutations in its DNA binding domain. We developed a method based on a reference-free tetrahedral representation of variation in base preference within a given structural family that can be used to accurately predict the effect of mutations in the protein sequence of the TF. Using the basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH) and homeodomain families as test cases, our results demonstrate the feasibility of accurately predicting the shifts (DeltaDeltaDeltaG/RT) in binding free energy associated with TF mutants by leveraging high-quality DNA binding models for sets of homologous wild-type TFs.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）与基因组DNA的序列特异性相互作用是许多细胞过程的基础。高通量体外结合实验结合机器学习，使得以生物物理学可解释的方式精确定义数百种跨多个结构家族的转录因子的这种分子识别成为可能，为预测转录因子DNA结合域中疾病相关突变如何影响其序列偏好提供了新途径。我们开发了一种基于无参考四面体表示的方法，用于描述给定结构家族内碱基偏好的变异，该方法可用于精确预测转录因子蛋白序列中突变的影响。以碱性螺旋-环-螺旋（bHLH）和同源异型域家族作为测试案例，我们的结果证明了通过利用一组同源野生型转录因子的高质量DNA结合模型，精确预测与转录因子突变体相关的结合自由能变化（DeltaDeltaDeltaG/RT）的可行性。
